purpose: P0-1 diagnostic evidence; no production selection/evaluation/fixture change. A criterion mismatch is not a proof of a bad move. Limited interventions cannot establish global optimality.

storage.runtimeReplay: Commands and completed task expected hashes retain worker order. Full progress and full legal move traces are in SHA256-identified local raw reports. Hashes were compared in Bun before packing.
storage.branchKeys: SHA256 of raw UTF-8 branch key; original complete-state key is stored once. This differs from the core observer key, which hashes JSON.stringify(key).
storage.interventionWitness: Only selected and injected rows are packed; all legal rows remain in each raw report. Positive interventions retain before/after PVs. Negative interventions retain values and actual chosen actions.
